notes.title: Ending Screen Update + New Achievements + Lighting Bugfixes!
notes.content:
Ending Screen Update + New Achievements + Lighting Bugfixes!

- New Ending Screen is available
- New Achievements
- Walls and Lighting bugs around Pitfalls are fixed
- Pipe Dreams small changes

notes.title: Level 0 (The Lobby) Update! Pitfalls are here!
notes.content:
Level 0 (The Lobby) Update! Pitfalls are available now! 
New stuff can be found on the map!

- Pitfalls have been added to Level 0
- You can find some guys "hanging out"
- New Paintings
- VHS Effect is OFF by default

notes.title: "Level !" is now in the Game & Level Restart option is now available!
notes.content:
[b]The Level "Run for your Life" (Level !) is now Out![/b]
[b]Now you can Restart the current level if you Die![/b]

- New Level is available
- New Entity is here, to greet you in the Backrooms
- Level Restart option on Death
- New Sounds
- Ambient Sound in the Habitable Zone
- 4 New Achievements are available!
- Bugfixes

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O7JnOoC.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8Rce9kB.png[/img]

notes.title: Habitable Zone Optimization Update!
notes.content:
Habitable Zone Optimization Update!
You should have more FPS now and walking back shouldn't be an issue anymore.
